verdict.rationale: Recurly documents an official public MCP server, Compass MCP, that lets AI agents such as Claude Desktop or Cursor "work directly with Recurly's tools and APIs." However, it is also described as connecting AI development tools to Recurly's "documentation and API knowledge," so it is unclear whether an agent can query live account billing state rather than just developer reference material. Missing for 10: evidence the agent can query live account data, specific support for MRR, delinquent-account, upcoming-renewal and per-customer invoice queries, documented auth/scoping for account data, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can answer questions about my billing state — MRR, delinquent accounts, upcoming renewals, a customer's invoices — by querying the platform directly

citations.quote: Recurly Compass MCP is a public MCP server that lets AI agents — such as Claude Desktop or Cursor — work directly with Recurly's tools and APIs, without complex setup.
Recurly Compass MCP connects your AI development tools directly to Recurly's documentation and API knowledge.
